applicabilityBasis.summary: sDAI is an ERC-4626 savings-vault share over DAI. Spark documentation identifies the legacy DAI Savings Rate vault and explains that each share accrues yield through an increasing redemption rate. The share has a variable DAI redemption value; it does not represent a fixed monetary-value issuer redemption obligation or a promise to maintain a fixed dollar unit value under GENIUS Act section 2(22).

references.label: Spark Savings documentation: sDAI legacy ERC-4626 vault share

genius.notes: This assessment concerns the vault-share token and the tracked payment-stablecoin issuer-authorization model only. The underlying stablecoin has a separate assessment. No GENIUS approval or exemption, securities-law determination, or blanket exclusion from other regulatory obligations is asserted. No legal fiat-redemption issuer is established by the product documentation, so issuerEntity is omitted.
